children.game_version: Follow-the-leader style line dance using simple, repetitive animal-themed movements.

seniors.seated_version: Perform footwork sequences while seated in a chair, focusing on leg extensions and rhythmic tapping.
seniors.standing_version: Use a chair for balance while executing simplified step patterns.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo; focus on smaller step ranges to maintain stability.

movement_profile.footwork: Repeating sequences of steps, shuffles, and turns.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Parallel lines; dancers move in unison.

signature_moves.description: A specific sequence of steps including a grapevine and a turn.
signature_moves.name: Electric Slide

music_profile.musical_form: Repeating song structures with clear, steady beats.
music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Repeating sequences often based on 32, 48, or 64 counts.
music_profile.sound_description: Recognizable by a consistent, driving beat that supports repetitive step patterns, often featuring a blend of acoustic country elements or electronic pop production.

basic_steps: Grapevine (step side, cross behind, step side, touch)
teaching.level_notes: Beginners typically learn 10-20 standard dances; advanced dancers may know hundreds.
teaching.rhythm: Typically 4/4 time, though waltz variations use 3/4.
